verdict.rationale: JumpCloud explicitly offers Cloud RADIUS and Cloud LDAP-style directory services designed to authenticate Wi-Fi, VPNs, switches, and legacy systems that don't speak SAML, with docs describing pointing network devices directly to JumpCloud's RADIUS servers. Community evidence also confirms real-world reliance on JumpCloud for fleet-wide directory/authentication services. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on validation of LDAP endpoint specifically, and no third-party report confirming RADIUS reliability at scale.
